design.purpose: Final confirmatory BASE vs dev-selected LIQ_ACCEL comparison in a one-Early-slot operational portfolio reconstruction.
design.core: Research DDV20 Core; Attack current V38 70% RS189 + 30% LOO Theme, Selective RS189; 12/4 caps; same exits.
design.early: DDV20 Radar; no Full Eligibility; no Blue/Green/Breadth entry gate; Red remains defense; one slot; same winner-holding exits; direct promotion when held Early reaches current Core candidate set.
design.LIQ_ACCEL: 80% BASE + 10% current DDV percentile + 10% DDV 10-session acceleration percentile; frozen by prior 2016-2020 audit.
design.primary_architecture: WITHIN12: Early1 is inside the existing 12-position gross envelope. A slot is reserved only when an Early signal exists.
design.architecture_sensitivity: OVERLAY13: Core12 + Early1, all slots normalized to 1/13 NAV; not a tuning candidate.
design.historical_note: The exact earlier Early1 implementation that produced the previously discussed CAGR is not present in the current research tree, so this audit does not claim byte-for-byte reproduction. It uses only the known current invariants and tests architecture sensitivity explicitly.
design.oos: 2021-2025 is confirmatory only; no coefficient or threshold is selected from it.
